title: Police Struggling With a Suspect Accused of Tasing a Police Officer
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
According to the Evansville Police Department, Twenty-two-year-old Logan Stidham was arrested Wednesday after the officer suffered facial injuries in the attack. The Evansville man is jailed without bond on charges that include battery with a deadly weapon and resisting law enforcement.
